tables.label: tab:main
tables.caption: Hypothesis 1: Mean Cumulative Abnormal Returns for Bank Stocks (KBE) Around FOMC Announcements
tables.notes: Cumulative abnormal returns measured in percent. Market model: daily KBE returns regressed on SPY returns over estimation window $[-250, -12]$ trading days. Columns marked ``Pre-Reg'' are from the pre-registered specification; columns marked ``Secondary'' are additional analyses not pre-registered. Standard errors in parentheses. $t$-statistics and $p$-values computed with $n-1$ degrees of freedom. */**/*** denote significance at the 10/5/1\% levels.

tables.label: tab:h2
tables.caption: Hypothesis 2: Sensitivity of Abnormal Returns to Treasury Yield Surprise, Event Window $[-1, +1]$
tables.notes: Cumulative abnormal returns regressed on the same-day change in the 2-year Treasury yield (DGS2), measured in basis points. OLS estimation with heteroskedasticity-consistent (HC1) standard errors. Standard errors in parentheses. $t$-statistics and $p$-values computed with reported degrees of freedom. */**/*** denote significance at the 10/5/1\% levels.
